semantic_notes.a06_public_state: Prompt explicitly states adversarial file contains exactly existing content. GPT tests use supplied bytes; this is not hidden fixture knowledge.
semantic_notes.opus55_a06_r0: Allows one LF or CRLF on baseline; forbids beginning anywhere in adversarial content but does not check exact preservation. Harmless stdout/stderr writes are rejected by the broad screen.
semantic_notes.opus55_a06_r1: Allows one LF on baseline; adversarial condition only excludes beginning and beginning+LF, so arbitrary unrelated modification can pass.
semantic_notes.a17: All model tests focus on disabled hash markers and account existence; none enforces the complete strengthened nine-field shadow integrity oracle. Both Opus repetitions contain nonliteral getent argument lists and are statically unavailable under the frozen contract.

limits: Manual source inspection is evidence for these16 observed programs, not a proof that the generic AST filter enforces noninterference for arbitrary generated code.
